game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Mt. Pyre – Ore Smelter, a smelter processing glowing ore: the lava scout must handle cinder bats while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Boolean Circuit: Toggle True/False switches so a combined and/or/not expression powers the fire shrine.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Ore Smelter: a smelter processing glowing ore
core_gameplay_loop: In Ore Smelter, repeat each round: Toggle True/False switches so a combined and/or/not expression powers the fire shrine. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the power_on value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the fire shrine using at most 19 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: The fire shrine reached with actions_used <= 19.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 19 before the fire shrine is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 2 (intro tier): Boolean Circuit
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Boolean Circuit' (Week 2 slot 6), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Ore Smelter'. region.name: Mt. Pyre

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how power_on changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against cinder bats in Ore Smelter.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The fire shrine reached with actions_used <= 19.
